mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a decline in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in labor market (PAYEMS growth rate below 0.5% annualized) and housing demand (HOUST growth rate below 0.3% annualized) indicates a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS growth and HOUST growth are below their respective thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 320.0), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 320.0 and FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320.0) and a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signal a restrictive monetary policy environment that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL exceeds 320.0 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong growth in real sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS growth is above 0.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1450.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1450.0.
